svg.aria-label: LD decay with generations, haplotype blocks with tagging SNPs, and a Manhattan plot
svg.text: LD decays as D₀(1−c)ᵗ — a population is a cross that has run for millennia

g.text: gen 2000 — only the closest loci remain correlated

svg.text: Linkage is about geography. LD is about history.
Tightly linked loci can be in perfect equilibrium.

g.text: hap 1: A G T C A G
hap 2: A G T T G G
hap 3: C A T C A A
hap 4: C A G T G A

svg.text: D′ = 1 means no recombination has occurred (history).
r² says how well one SNP predicts another — and N_tag = N / r².
a TOWER, not a point — LD makes neighbours agree
A lone significant SNP is usually an artefact.
